items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 19.11.2026 (Thursday), which is the start event of the period under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, so this day is not counted. Counting 14 days begins on 20.11.2026 (day 1) and ends on day 14 = 03.12.2026 (Thursday). 03.12.2026 is a regular working day in NW (no public holiday), so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Payment is owed to a private company (payer's own Land, NW, is relevant for holiday check, but irrelevant here since no holiday falls on the date).
